messages:
oncall-bot: PAGING — multiple 5xx/connection errors observed for HelixBank (private VPC) egress to downstream payment API. Alert: >50% of flows failing, spike since 12:41 UTC. Automated mitigation attempted: none (tenant uses private NLB path).
oncall-bot: Incident created https://incidents.internal/2003456789
Sam R: I’m on it. Checking VPC egress metrics + NLB target health.
Priya N: I’m looking at security group changes in the last 30m. No config PRs on record.
Carlos G: I can pull host conntrack metrics from the dedicated nat-proxy. Sharing logs now.
Maya (netops): FYI HelixBank is on private VPC with NLB egress -> NAT fleet in customer account. Could be conntrack / ephemeral port exhaustion.
Sam R: Copy. Sam->Carlos can you paste netstat/conntrack snapshot?
Carlos G: Paste logs: ```
# conntrack -S
cpu 0 num 124812
entries 124812
found 120K
expect 0
```
Carlos G: conntrack count near max (115k/120k). Lots of CLOSE_WAIT to payment-api:443.
Priya N: Security groups look unchanged. I see a burst of SYN_RECV on NLB health checks around 12:39.
Sam R: Can we confirm NLB target group health? `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tgrp-helix-egress` returns many unhealthy targets (503 drain).
Maya (netops): NLB is in pass-through mode; unhealthy targets mean NAT fleet nodes losing backend connections or hitting conntrack.
incident-bot: Added label: customer-impact/partial; severity/P2. Notifying Tier 2 SRE.
Sam R: Short mitigation plan: 1) throttle new connections (rate-limit) 2) temporarily scale NAT fleet (add 3 instances) 3) increase conntrack capacity on proxy hosts 4) failover HelixBank traffic to Redwood Dedicated pool if needed.
Priya N: I can open the SG to allow ephemeral range 32768-61000 temporarily if that's causing established flows to fail? But SGs typically allow established.
Carlos G: Increasing conntrack sysctl is quick: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and persist in /etc/sysctl.conf. Doing on nat-proxy-3 now.
Sam R: I'm triggering autoscale for nat-proxy ASG +3. `deploy-bot: asg scale nat-proxy-asg +3 (requested by Sam R)`
deploy-bot: ASG scale request accepted, adding 3 instances (expected ready in ~4m).
Maya (netops): I see the new instances initializing. Also bumping NLB connection draining timeout to 120s to avoid premature target failures.
CS-Jess: @Sam R can we get a quick one-liner for HelixBank about partial egress failures and a temporary mitigation? They are calling ops.
Sam R: Quick draft: "We're investigating intermittent outbound failures from your private VPC to the payment provider. We're scaling NAT capacity and applying a temporary kernel-level increase to connection tracking; no planned restarts. We'll update in 10 mins." Use that.
TenantOps-Bob: Customer-facing ticket created. Notified customer success and assigned to HelixBank's TAM.
Carlos G: After kernel bump on 3 hosts conntrack usage dropped from 98%->42% over 90s. Logs: ```
Mar 15 12:45:01 nat-proxy-3 conntrack[pid]: entries 256000
Mar 15 12:45:35 nat-proxy-3 conntrack[pid]: est 12k
```
Priya N: SG change not required yet, leaving as-is.
Sam R: Monitoring: egress success rate bumped from 48% -> 92% after scale + sysctl. But a subset still failing because NLB still shows 2 unhealthy targets.
Maya (netops): Those two are in a different AZ; their instances failed health checks due to ephemeral port depletion. I'm reattaching targets after clearing conntrack on them.
Sam R: Re-run target-health check. `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tgrp-helix-egress` -> all healthy 3/3.
incident-bot: Update: severity downgraded to P3 (partial degradation mitigated).
CS-Jess: Shared the update with HelixBank: they acknowledged and asked for RCA and a timeline for permanent fix.
Priya N: Next steps: schedule infra change to persist conntrack_max, add alert for conntrack >80%, and add automated scale-out when conntrack >75% for private VPC NAT ASGs.
Sam R: Agree. Also propose adding fallback routing to Redwood Dedicated pool for critical egress paths (opt-in by customer) — Ops doc to author.
Carlos G: I'll prepare post-incident logs and firewall traces.
Sam R: Thanks team. Handing off to Priya for RCA and follow-up actions. Priya, take the on-call.
Priya N: Taking over. I'll open the postmortem, include timelines, mitigations, and customer comms.
Maya (netops): Closing note — DNS was fine (TTL 60s), no evidence of external provider issue. Root cause: conntrack exhaustion on customer NAT fleet causing NLB target flapping -> egress failures.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Postmortem assigned to Priya N, due in 72h.
Sam R: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
